# ETHIndia Institutional briefing: Tokenised settlement in India

> A seven-module briefing, drawn from published sources, on Ethereum and distributed-settlement infrastructure for Indian institutional finance. Every claim carries a source and date; every quantitative figure carries a source tier (T1 primary … T5 crypto media/aggregator) in the Figure Ledger.

## Pages
- [ETHIndia Institutional](https://institutions.ethindia.co/)
- [Briefing overview](https://institutions.ethindia.co/briefing)
- [A. What shipped](https://institutions.ethindia.co/briefing/a)
- [B. What's legal in India](https://institutions.ethindia.co/briefing/b)
- [C. Where the value is](https://institutions.ethindia.co/briefing/c)
- [D. Ethereum vs alternatives](https://institutions.ethindia.co/briefing/d)
- [E. The privacy question](https://institutions.ethindia.co/briefing/e)
- [F. The objections](https://institutions.ethindia.co/briefing/f)
- [G. How adoption happens](https://institutions.ethindia.co/briefing/g)
- [Figure Ledger](https://institutions.ethindia.co/briefing/ledger)
- [Reconciliation](https://institutions.ethindia.co/briefing/reconciliation)

## Data
- [Figure Ledger data (JSON)](https://institutions.ethindia.co/data/figures.json) — every quantitative claim with its claim, figure, unit, source, date, tier and flags.
- Each Figure Ledger row is anchored as /briefing/ledger#fig-<ID>. Cite that anchor, with the row's tier and as-of date, when quoting a figure.
- Each module page has three reading depths, anchored #tier-30s, #tier-5min and #tier-full.
